effects.before: No public fixed small-tree package source witness with complete selected-file membership and physical root observation.
effects.after: Public capture/recheck/attest helpers witness one exact qualified package tree with bounded nofollow file census, root identity and digest; drift is detection-bound, not atomic hostile-writer CAS.
effects.audience: Rust library consumer / internal install owner
effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux fixture proof; native macOS/Windows tree behavior unrun.

effects.before: The fixed one-package protected Install fixture had no package-tree source witness in its v3 plan or early attach before post-effect preflight.
effects.after: The internal plan binds the witnessed tree; same-key request attach can read the retained run before changed post-effect lock/files are re-planned, and a staged one-package fixture demonstrates the slot/lock/boot effect. No general machine Install route is exposed.
effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux fixture tests; no general installation or native macOS/Windows proof.

user_impact.reason: Additive public bounded PackageTreeWitness Rust API; protected Install remains fixture-only and no existing 1.0.x user-owned state requires conversion.

documentation_impact.reason: Document bounded public tree-witness selection/caps and cooperative drift limits, plus internal v3 plan/early-attach fixture boundary; final topic/editorial proof pending.
